notSaved.label: Not saved

reason.refused: Your account refused the last change.
reason.clubTooLarge: A club is too big to save. Remove some players or images from it.

reason.tooMany: Your account has the most clubs it can hold (50). Delete one to save a new one.
reason.badData: A club couldn't be read and wasn't saved.
reason.quota: Your image storage is full. Delete images you no longer use to make room.
reason.imageTooBig: Images can be up to {side} pixels on the longest side.
reason.notAnImage: That file isn't an image we can read.
